subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this issue remain the umbrella for Control UI reply metadata plus no-output UX, or should maintainers split it across the structured reply metadata work and the durable final-fallback delivery contract?
rationale: Current main still lacks a structured Control UI/Gateway reply target contract while the no-output half overlaps a separate maintainer-owned final-fallback contract, so automation should not choose the permanent ownership boundary.

options.title: Split across existing work
options.body: Track structured reply metadata through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 or a maintainer replacement, and keep no-output final fallback semantics under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561.

options.title: Keep this umbrella
options.body: Leave this issue open as the cross-surface coordination item until a single maintainer-approved design covers both halves.

options.title: Defer structured metadata
options.body: Treat quote-text Control UI replies as sufficient for now and keep only the no-output/final-fallback work active.

recommendation.title: Split across existing work
recommendation.body: Track structured reply metadata through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 or a maintainer replacement, and keep no-output final fallback semantics under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main source trail for the UI, protocol, runtime-context, and final-event surfaces points to vincentkoc, with adjacent candidate owners available for narrower slices.
